productName: AuraMaster Pro Waveform Synthesis & Dynamic Spectral Suite
targetAudience: Professional mastering engineers, sound designers, and electronic music producers
operationalContext: Acoustically treated studio, calibrated 4K monitors, multi-hour listening sessions, low ambient light
dataVisualizationNeeds: Real-time FFT audio spectrum analyzer, stereo correlation goniometer, parametric EQ curve, LUFS loudness meter

concepts.identityRationale: Dark, immersive, ultra-precise studio workbench inspired by premium hardware mastering gear (e.g. Manley, Weiss). Eliminates screen glare to keep engineer focus on acoustic fidelity and microscopic frequency adjustments.

layout.columnGrid: Modular rack chassis (Upper: Spectral Display 60%, Lower: Parametric Band Controls 40%)
layout.focalPoint: Real-time interactive frequency response curve and dynamic bell filters

surface.elevationModel: Recessed dark chassis with subtle metallic 1px borders (#1E293B) and tactile rotary detents

primaryCharts: True Peak / LUFS multi-segment LED meter
dataVisualization.telemetryDensity: Real-time continuous audio frequency processing at 60fps

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (14.5:1 on studio chassis)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Designed specifically for dim mixing studio ambient lighting (20–50 lux)

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Maximum signal precision; engineers can adjust 0.1dB gain increments effortlessly
uxTradeoffs.risks: Requires professional audio engineering knowledge to operate parametric bands
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Gold standard for mastering engineers and post-production houses

concepts.identityRationale: Bauhaus-inspired tactile sound design lab. Emphasizes geometric purity, high-contrast monochrome knobs, and stark typography reminiscent of legendary Swiss industrial hi-fi equipment (Braun / Dieter Rams).

layout.columnGrid: Asymmetrical 12-column grid with bold modular rotary tiles and stark white parameter cards
layout.focalPoint: Oversized dynamic frequency dial and warm orange master gain fader

surface.elevationModel: Tactile surface panels with 1.5px structural borders (#CBD5E1) and crisp matte finishes

iconography.geometry: Pure circles, triangles, and squares reflecting Bauhaus design

dataVisualization.telemetryDensity: Cleaned harmonic frequency curves with focus on aesthetic simplicity

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (15.2:1 dark on white card)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Optimized for well-lit boutique production studios and design workshops

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Iconic, memorable design identity; extremely intuitive and inviting for electronic artists
uxTradeoffs.risks: Less space for 32-band micro-surgical EQ graphs
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Best for music producers, beatmakers, and creative synthesizer sound designers
